record.text: Session tool evidence `tool:<Name>[#n]` is resolved by `resolveToolEvidence` in packages/tools/taskmanage/src/task-manage.ts. Only session message entries with role 'toolResult' and a string toolName count; name matching is exact, with a single-target alias fallback when the name is absent from results. Index n is 1-based per tool name, chronological, and must satisfy 1 <= n <= count on the current branch (getBranch()). Failures produce `tool_result_unavailable` with hints listing available `tool:<Name>#<count>` refs. Evidence stored in tasks is canonicalized to the alias target when an alias resolves.
